videos.title: Headroom: The Netflix Tool That Makes AI Agents 10x Cheaper
videos.description:
Headroom is an open-source tool that compresses everything your AI agent reads, tool outputs, code files, and RAG results, before it reaches the LLM, cutting token usage by 60-95%. Built by a Netflix engineer, it uses content-type-aware compressors and runs its own locally trained Kompress-based model, so compression costs zero tokens, and your code stays on your machine. If the model needs the full original, a breadcrumb hash lets it retrieve it on demand. It pairs perfectly with output-side tools like Caveman for maximum token savings.
